MultiCardioFusion pipeline
nodes.rationale: Leakage-aware: imputation, feature derivation, scaling and resampling fitted inside training folds only; framed as ECG-proxy-enhanced clinical prediction, not patient-level multimodal fusion, because Cleveland and PTB-XL contain different patients.

nodes.label: PTB-XL ECG dataset
nodes.records: 21,799 records from 18,869 patients; 9,097 normal, 12,702 abnormal; stratified sample 303 (126 normal, 177 abnormal, seed 42)

nodes.label: External validation on three UCI hospitals
nodes.sites: Hungary n=294 AUC 0.889; Switzerland n=123 AUC 0.772; VA Long Beach n=200 AUC 0.709 (fused)

nodes.label: ECG-proxy feature block
nodes.rationale: Derived from restecg, oldpeak, slope, thalach, exang (5 raw + 18 derived); proxy-only dAUC -0.089; performs no better than added noise because features are deterministic functions of variables classifiers already see.

nodes.label: Lead II single-lead choice
nodes.rationale: Lies close to mean electrical axis, standard rhythm-strip lead; keeps feature space manageable for N=303. Lead II Efficient AUC 0.819.

nodes.label: SMOTE oversampling
nodes.rationale: Removing SMOTE changes AUC by -0.002; creates implausible non-integer categorical codes; class weighting or no correction recommended.

nodes.label: Cross-attention with sequence length 1
nodes.rationale: With L=1 softmax over a single score gives weight exactly 1, reducing to a linear map of the clinical branch; removed from proposed system and reported only as ablation.

nodes.label: SHAP stability analysis
nodes.values: fold-to-fold Spearman 0.90; top-5 Jaccard 0.74; seed Spearman 0.95; vs permutation importance 0.27

nodes.label: Seed-42 61-patient hold-out split
nodes.rationale: v4 headline numbers came from it; seed 42 lies at 95th percentile of 200 random splits for fused accuracy.

nodes.label: Negative control experiments
nodes.result: Gaussian noise 0.899, non-ECG features 0.903, row-shuffled proxy 0.897

nodes.label: Probability calibration
nodes.detail: Platt scaling slope 1.13 Brier 0.125; isotonic slope 0.56

nodes.label: ca and thal dominant predictors
nodes.rationale: Results of advanced diagnostic tests; model is a post-test classifier, not a screening tool.

nodes.label: MultiCardioFusion v4 manuscript
nodes.claims: AUC 0.9535, +7.04 pp fusion gain; not supported under controlled protocol

nodes.label: RQ1 ECG-proxy features vs clinical alone
nodes.answer: No; dAUC +0.004 [-0.009,+0.017] in favour of clinical-only

nodes.label: RQ2 pipeline component contributions
nodes.answer: No component produces significant gain after multiplicity correction

nodes.label: RQ3 robustness
nodes.answer: Conclusions unchanged under 16 perturbations, subgroups, three external sites

nodes.label: RQ4 SHAP stability
nodes.answer: Top of ranking (cp, ca, thal) stable; tail unstable
